title: Write a new contributor quest
summary: Know a small job that would help Aven? Write it up as a quest so the next person can do it.
why: Good first tasks are how open-source projects welcome new people.

steps.text: Read quests/README.md to see how quests are written.
Copy a quest file like quests/teach-the-doctor.json and change it for your idea. Keep steps short, one action each.
Check that it's valid JSON and shows up in this list after a restart.

submit: Open a pull request with the new quest file. Put 'Quest: write-a-quest' in the description.
